    "Model forecasts are consistently too low by 0.15-0.25 for the first 10-15 days, showing significant lag behind price momentum",

    "When price history shows strong upward trend (last 5 days up), model underforecasts by 0.4-0.8 for the first week",
    "Model mean-reverts to historical means (62.5-66.5 range) but true prices exhibit more volatility, causing 10-20% relative error in forecast magnitude",
    "Sentiment strength correlates with forecast accuracy - weak sentiment (0.00 or -0.33) regions have 40% more errors than strong sentiment (0.67-1.00) regions",
    "The forecast curve is too smooth - true outcomes have 2-3x more variance for the first 15 days",
    "Model fails to capture short-term mean reversion lag, forecasting levels that are 0.2-0.4 too far from current prices"
] }
